designSummary: Random-effects meta-analysis within each comparison class where at least three studies report a comparable outcome; otherwise structured synthesis without meta-analysis.
sampleSize: No sample size applies to a review. The preliminary search found one direct screening study, so pooling within the screening class may not be possible; support studies may pool.
primaryAnalysis: Standardised mean difference in burden at about 12 months with 95 percent confidence and prediction intervals, within each comparison class, never across classes.
secondaryAnalysis: Depression, care home admission, referral uptake; subgroups by relationship, gender and language where reported.
missingData: Authors contacted once; studies without usable data described, not imputed.
overfittingGuards: No meta-regression with fewer than ten studies
